issue.title: `bulkSave()` should throw error when a document doesn't exist in DB matching `save()`
issue.body:
Currently `save()` throws a `DocumentNotFoundError` when a document has no changes and doesn't exist in DB, while `bulkSave()` doesn't handle this scenario.
Given that my intent of `bulkSave()` was to replace multiple `save()`s with a single DB call, I expect it to strictly behave the same way.

Should we `find()` all the documents that have no changes, and throw an error if one of them doesn't exist in `ordered: true` (run all operations all the way until the first non-existent doc), and for `ordered: false`, throw an error after? WDYT? @vkarpov15 @hasezoey
